verdicts.evidence: The SLM confidence-set construction is instantiated with a classical log-domain SART reconstruction on a synthetic phantom (r=32, 40 views, I0=1e4), but the deep-learning instantiations (U-Nets, ensembles, diffusion) are explicitly not reproduced due to missing checkpoints.

Coverage was empirically tested on a synthetic phantom with 300 Poisson realisations per delta, yielding 1.000 coverage at delta=0.10 and 0.05, supporting the finite-sample validity on a clearly reduced setup.
The Lamino industrial CT dataset is never used; the logbook only runs on a synthetic phantom, so the NLL gap comparison between diffusion, MLE, and FBP is not addressed.
The Lamino dataset is not used; coverage is tested only on a synthetic phantom, so the claim about empirical crossover rates on Lamino is not addressed.

The Composite materials dataset and diffusion-based method are not used; the logbook does not address miscoverage rates or tightness comparisons against worst-case optimization or bootstrap baselines.
The hallucination-detection application of Section 4.7 is not mentioned or tested anywhere in the logbook.

overall: The logbook reproduces only the coverage guarantee of the SLM framework on a small synthetic phantom with classical SART reconstruction, showing conservative 1.000 coverage at delta=0.10 and 0.05. It does not address the Lamino or Composite materials datasets, any deep-learning reconstructor, or the hallucination-detection application.
